title: Working together and clearer mobile Notes headers
changes: Removed the duplicate sidebar button from the mobile Notes editor and separated the back, Preview, Publish, and more controls so they stay readable and easy to tap on narrow screens.
Left-aligned note titles and dates on mobile, including shared previews.
Moved engagement models to /working-together, renamed the page Working together, and permanently redirected /engagement-models to the new address.
Working together now opens after securely saving an email address, with queued notifications and automatic retries so email quotas or delivery outages do not block access.
Updated the About portrait with a color photo in light mode and a black-and-white photo in dark mode, with both crops aligned to the top.
Fixed missing About portraits on the live site by including both images in deployments.

title: Email signup from the Notes index
changes: Added email signup and an RSS subscription link beside the Notes list, with a narrower sticky sidebar that clears the menu button on larger screens and a frosted Subscribe pill that expands into a signup modal on smaller screens.
The shared email signup layout now adapts to its own width on the Notes index and individual notes.
The mobile Subscribe modal opens without automatically focusing a button or input and closes without focusing the Subscribe pill. Keyboard navigation and Escape dismissal remain available.
Made section headings in Notes emails slightly heavier for clearer separation from the body text.

Polished Notes with matching mobile header and page margins, visually balanced year labels in a subtler color on mobile, matching title and signup heading typography, generous mobile year spacing that becomes compact when sticky, year-to-note gaps that match the title spacing, clearer signup and RSS link spacing, softer card corners, a transparent desktop signup card and an email field without a visible border in dark mode, natural wrapping for list titles and mobile article titles, and chevrons that stay beside the final word with improved vertical alignment.

title: Easier subscriptions to Notes
changes: RSS readers can now discover the Notes feed from the homepage and individual posts, as well as the Notes index.

title: A running history of the site
changes: Added an unlisted changelog with dated summaries and expandable commit details stretching back to the first version of the site.
Made changelog updates part of the development workflow, with a history importer and an automated check for missing entries.

title: Scheduled notes and a better reading experience in your inbox
changes: Notes can be scheduled for a future publish date, with clearer scheduling, preview, publish, and unpublish controls.
Newsletter emails now include the full essay, with a title, comfortable reading margins, and a quieter subscription footer.
Added an Edit link to note previews and refined prose underlines, list alignment, editor menus, and dashboard headers.

title: Share a draft before it goes live
changes: Added private share previews for unpublished notes, including article titles in shared previews.
Restored email signup for notes, improved confirmation emails, and added notifications for confirmed subscriptions.
Made room for multiple untitled drafts and refined title wrapping, heading weights, links, and editor navigation.
Organized the admin sidebar into Site and Operations and centered the engagement access form.

title: A new entry point for working together
changes: Added email access to the engagement models page and refreshed its layout.

title: A different first impression on every visit
changes: The homepage project slideshow now starts in a randomized order on each visit.

title: Horizontal swiping returns to the mobile homepage
changes: Restored horizontal mobile slideshow navigation and its pagination.

title: Smoother slides and quieter highlights
changes: Refined desktop slideshow image and title transitions, trackpad gestures, button hover states, and translucent pagination tracks.
Highlight attribution now dismisses when the pointer leaves and stays above floating controls on narrow screens.

title: Your highlights, and everyone else’s
changes: Distinguished personal highlights from community highlights, with separate visibility controls for each.
Added hover fills and corner attribution messages, and refined the highlight popover’s size and shadow.
Added desktop trackpad swipes to the homepage slideshow, kept recommendation arrows with their titles, and corrected site copy.

title: Ways to work together, and a more readable site
changes: Added the engagement models page.
Published Markdown versions of About, Work, and Notes for AI agents, alongside structured page metadata.
Expanded the weekly email digest to cover site activity beyond chats, and refined project card interactions and editing.

title: Roll the credits
changes: Added a Credits page with cinematic playback and controls that dock above the footer.
Moved Photos into the main navigation, made navigation items reorderable, removed Timeline from the footer, and made Home return to the top.
Sharpened mobile slideshow images, refined Safari pagination and edge treatments, and fixed wrapped device frames and empty like spacing.

title: A faster, more considered foundation
changes: Added momentum dragging to the work marquee and editable capability and industry labels to homepage slides.
Improved mobile slideshow sizing, pagination, and loading; reduced image weight and deferred work that is offscreen.
Refined note typography, social previews, activity controls, and highlight protections.
Added a recent edits feed and improved mobile admin menus, lists, timestamps, and sidebar behavior.
Improved keyboard and reduced-motion accessibility, search metadata, request validation, and signup limits. Updated dependencies and added repeatable quality checks.

title: Highlight the parts that stay with you
changes: Added public highlights to notes, including touch selection, visibility controls, reader location and time attribution, and a mobile highlights sheet.
Added note highlights to the activity feed and a floating article control for highlights, views, and likes.
Added article dates, three reading recommendations, and custom social images for published notes.
Refined heading hierarchy, links, body colors, dark mode, and editor typography. Fixed republishing edited notes.
Stabilized mobile homepage pagination as browser toolbars resize, and temporarily hid email signup while refining the subscription flow.

title: A new homepage, and a home for Notes
changes: Refreshed the homepage with an editable project slideshow, a liked-work marquee, and an updated Approach section. Refined portraits, clients, project content, and navigation.
Introduced Notes with a focused writing editor and imported the Patina essays. Added a year-grouped index, article pages, inline images, likes, and reading recommendations.
Added RSS and email subscriptions, date-aware publishing, dark mode editing, and Notes in the site navigation.
Built native mobile slideshow snapping and swipe pagination, with project links and smoother movement into the next section.
Added recently edited content to the admin dashboard and improved chat privacy, request limits, and response handling.

title: Conversations join the activity feed
changes: Added chats to the activity feed, with session grouping, locations, and country flags.
Unified activity view controls, refined mobile back navigation, and adjusted phone previews in the feed.

title: A timeline that keeps up
changes: The life timeline now stays current through today instead of ending at a fixed date.

title: A clearer voice in chat
changes: Improved the chat persona and support for formatted lists in responses.
Linked the About biography to the life timeline.

title: Faces through the years
changes: Added age-specific portraits to the timeline, along with a future-age Easter egg.
Refined date picking, horizontal and age scrubbing, portrait positioning, early Cuba locations, and the treatment of dates beyond the present.
Fixed follow-up questions in chat.

title: A little more life in the globe
changes: Refined the timeline globe with solid land shapes, hover parallax, and more pronounced rotation.

title: More ways to explore the timeline
changes: Added city-level locations and a location globe, linked people and projects within chapters, and pointed news items to individual articles.
Improved scrubbing, chapter taps, mobile positioning, and desktop scroll sensitivity. The timeline now opens at the prologue.
Made chapter links editable, added Timeline to the footer, and restored the presentation of website project modules.

title: A life, on a timeline
changes: Added an interactive life timeline with chapters, ages, locations, and world events.
Made chapters editable with rich text and added links to historical news.
Refined chapter navigation, hover details, mobile pull gestures, and layout around Safari’s browser controls.

title: More room for photos
changes: Expanded the photo gallery to the full page width, with a column count that adapts to the viewport.
Made the media upload installation patch safe to apply repeatedly.

title: Less friction when adding images
changes: Added inline media uploads directly from editor fields, with visible progress.
Fixed drag-and-drop upload saving and improved photo management, gallery loading, lightbox behavior, and activity handling.

title: A visual media library
changes: Added a masonry view to the admin media library.

title: Take a closer look
changes: Added photo lightbox zoom interactions, including trackpad pinch-to-zoom.

title: A better place to manage the site
changes: Polished the admin dashboard, login, sidebar, account menu, and page ordering, including mobile layouts and controls.
Improved media and photo upload workflows, photo detail controls, mobile preview sizing, and the activity feed.
Updated footer navigation, moved Chat into the footer, and fixed deployment type issues.

title: Photography gets its own space
changes: Added a photo gallery and Photoring JSON feed, then connected photos to the CMS with individual permalinks.
Opened gallery photos in the site lightbox and included camera metadata and capture dates from original images.
Restored the three-column footer with email and social links, and removed one-off content setup files.

title: Say hello directly
changes: Added a contact form to the site.
Refined the chat experience with conversation summaries, sidebar improvements, and updates to the map and activity presentation.

title: A more connected portfolio
changes: Added an Ask Me Anything experience and refined chat headers, video controls, navigation, and page transitions.
Enabled the project lightbox from the activity feed and improved mobile phone zoom, swipe, and return transitions.
Unified avatar rendering across the site.

title: Lighter pages, steadier interactions
changes: Fixed mobile phone previews and restored responsive image optimization.
Reduced activity data, database work, offscreen like controls, scroll overhead, and deployment assets.
Refined the full-width chat layout and sidebar behavior, strengthened CMS secret handling, and cleaned up dependencies and unused code.

title: Smoother zooming into projects
changes: Refined lightbox opening transitions and performance, with gestures that stay on the intended swipe axis.

title: Project details, up close
changes: Added a lightbox for project modules and iterated on zooming from the original card into the expanded view.
Fixed avatar image sizing and adjusted the deployment migration workflow.

title: A tidier activity feed
changes: Improved activity grouping and video previews, updated content sync, and refined the context used by chat.

title: Likes, superlikes, and a little feedback
changes: Added likes and superlike interactions to project modules.
Included superlikes in the activity feed and backfilled earlier superlike activity.

title: Less data behind the scenes
changes: Reduced CMS data transfer in preparation for a database migration.

title: Refreshed projects and content tools
changes: Updated project content and assets, the About page, page editing, media rendering, and CMS synchronization tools.

title: More reliable content migrations
changes: Added a CMS migration workflow and fixed a mismatch in the clients database structure.

title: A dedicated home for conversations
changes: Added a standalone Chat page with a collapsible sidebar and a map view.
Moved the map to Mapbox, gave it its own URL, and refined navigation between chat views.

title: Easier uploads and a more useful digest
changes: Fixed media uploads by automatically filling missing alt text, and added a summary to the conversation digest.

title: One weekly catch-up
changes: Replaced individual chat email alerts with a scheduled weekly digest.

title: A livelier client marquee
changes: Increased the speed of the scrolling client logos.

title: More personal testimonials
changes: Added client logos and avatar tooltips to testimonials, with logos that adapt to light and dark mode.
Made testimonials reorderable in the editor and fixed related build issues.

title: Meet the people behind the work
changes: Added a People page with a photo grid and role filters, plus a new navigation menu and page transitions.
Reorganized the admin and improved people and company editing.
Added timeouts and automatic retries to make chat failures easier to recover from.

title: A quieter database
changes: Cached chat context, reduced conversation save frequency, and increased page caching to cut database usage.

title: Better conversation starters
changes: Added a set of 30 curated chat questions with rich-text answers, showing four randomized suggestions at a time.
Improved links to talks and interviews, email notification reliability, mobile chat spacing, and sidebar scrolling.
Added scheduling for seasonal overlays, including aurora and star effects.

title: Conversations worth continuing
changes: Added follow-up question suggestions, shareable conversation links, and retries for failed responses.
Linked people, side projects, talks, and interviews from chat answers, and refined response tone, length, and handling of vague questions.
Improved mobile chat sizing, automatic scrolling, dark mode avatars, homepage spacing, and email notifications.

title: Ask the portfolio a question
changes: Replaced the FAQ with an AI chat experience, including suggested prompts and mobile layouts.
Added saved conversation history, a sidebar, session persistence, and email notifications.
Improved answer context, client details and active status, and Projector content.

title: More reliable side project links
changes: Fixed broken image URLs and added slugs to side projects.

title: Small touches across the site
changes: Made birthday balloons respond to mobile device motion.
Refined avatar and image borders, video sizing, title alignment, and the About photo. Restored missing side project images.
Served images directly from the media store to reduce image optimization usage.

title: Birthday balloons
changes: Added an interactive birthday overlay with balloons, confetti, and a donation link for KIND.
Refined the balloon physics and mobile layout, made the availability badge open email, and removed unused components.

title: More devices, simpler editing
changes: Added iPhone X and iPhone 6 project frames and reorganized site settings and navigation.

title: Faster loading and finer details
changes: Added an iPhone 5 frame, momentum scrolling, centered testimonial snapping, and navigation improvements.
Introduced page caching and lazy video loading, optimized images and bundles, and fixed a font-loading issue.
Refined typography, hover states, mobile spacing, client logos, and the About photo in dark mode.

title: A better stage for the work
changes: Added DC-1 and iPhone 15 device frames, improved video blocks, and introduced a more flexible image grid.
Synchronized featured projects with the scrolling project list and polished cards, hover states, links, and mobile layouts.

title: The first version of this site
changes: Created the portfolio with a content management system and set up hosting and media storage.
Added dedicated side project pages for Talk Turkey and Makeshift, with links from About and hover-to-play videos.
Refined responsive layouts for project media, talks, interviews, playground items, and patents. Added client logos and social icons.
Moved media storage to Cloudflare R2 and resolved early deployment and image-serving issues.
